header: WHAT THE SEARCH LINE NEEDS TO KNOW ABOUT THIS TOPIC (pure, no React): the words of the headlines card, and the language a line asks for ("hindi news"). I left the data cards and their sources in src/lib/live and src/components/tools/live. How it looks in the panel is in ui.tsx; its logic is in the files beside this one. I list it once, in src/tools/registry.ts.

doc: The papers the card reads, by the names a line may call them, and the tab each opens ("dainik bhaskar" opens the Hindi tab). I take only whole names: "bhaskar" alone is a person's name and opens nothing.

symbols.name: PAPER_TAB
symbols.sig: const PAPER_TAB = new Map(PAPERS.flatMap(([names, tab]) => names.map((n): [string, string] => [n.replace(/ /g, "_"), tab])))
